MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D: REGISTRY
No. I. Q. D. 2......1929
Shanghai, January 27th......1929
Date....................

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Political

The following notables arrived from Nanking at the
Shanghai North at 11 a.m. January 26:

Mr. T.V.Soong, Minister of Finance.
Mr. Sun Fo, Minister of Railways
Mr. Wong Peh Chuen, Minister of Communications.
Mr. Chao Lih Tsz, member of the C.E.C⁷ of Kuomintang.

The following notables arrived from Nanking at the Shanghai
North at 7.50 a.m. January 27:-

General Chiang Kai-shek, Commander-in-Chief of the 1st
Group Army.
General Chu Pei Teh, Chairman of the Kiangsi Provincial
Government.

On arrival, General Chiang proceeded to the residence of Mr.
T.L.Soong, No.139 Seymour Road.

CHIN

工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处：登记室
编号 I. Q. D. 2......1929
上海，1929年1月27日
日期....................

情报报告。
政治类

下列要员于1月26日上午11时自南京抵达上海北站：

财政部长宋子文先生。
铁道部长孙科先生。
交通部长王伯群先生。
国民党中央执行委员赵利兹（音译）先生。

下列要员于1月27日上午7时50分自南京抵达上海北站：

第一集团军总司令蒋介石将军。
江西省政府主席朱培德将军。

抵达后，蒋将军前往西摩路139号宋子良先生寓所。

CHIN

page_data.en:
MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 27, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Military

In accordance with a confidential order of the General
Military Headquarters at Nanking received by the Director of the
Kiangnan Arsenal instructing that all munitions manufactured
be
and stored at the Arsenal removed elsewhere, 14 carloads of
mountain guns, stokes guns, machine guns, and rifles, and
ammunition were despatched from the Shanghai South to Nangchow
at 7.55 p.m. January 26. Twenty six cars are now being held
in readiness at the South Station to transport more munitions
out of the Arsenal. It is thought that this order has been
issued owing to resentment shown by naval leaders to Feng Yu-
hsiang's attempt to bring the Admiralty under his control.

126 infantry, 6th Company, 2nd Battalion, 15th Regiment,
8th Brigade, 3rd Division, left Fengking for Sungkiang at
3 p.m. January 26.
page_data.zh:
工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处。
上海，1929年1月27日。

情报报告。
军事类

根据南京国民革命军总司令部向江南兵工厂总监下达的一项密令，指示将兵工厂制造并储存的所有军火转移至他处，14车皮的山炮、斯托克斯迫击炮、机枪、步枪及弹药于1月26日下午7时55分自上海南站发往常州。目前另有26节车皮在南站待命，以便将更多军火运出兵工厂。据信，发布此令是由于海军将领对冯玉祥试图控制海军部之举表示不满。

第三师第八旅第十五团第二营第六连步兵126人，于1月26日下午3时离开奉化前往松江。

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 27, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Labour

The strike situation in the Sun Sun Co., No.145 Nanking
Road, remains unchanged. Some 30 members of the Strike'
Committee held a meeting between 2 p.m. and 3.30 p.m. January 26
1929, in the offices of their union at No.7 Kung Yih Li, off
North Thibet Road, U.O.L., and passed the following resolutions:

1. That the local Kuomintang Headquarters be requested to
endeavour to secure the release of Chao Soong Ling (趙松林);
who was arrested by the Municipal Police outside the Sun Sun
Co. Building on the forenoon of January 26 for intimidation.

2. That the local Kuomintang Headquarters be requested to apply
to have a warrant issued for the arrest of the two running
dogs named Pan Chi Ming (潘志明), and Sun Sao Pei (孫少白)
who caused the Police to arrest Chao.

3. That a general meeting of strikers be held at 9 a.m. January
28 at a place to be fixed later.

A strike picket named Chao Sung Ling was arrested at 11.30
a.m. January 26, on Weichow Road for attempting to force a worker
of the Sun Sun Company to go to Chapei and join the Labour Union
He will be brought before the Provisional Court on January 28.

About 1,000 female workers of the Pootung Factory of the
British Cigarette Company struck work at 7 a.m. January 26, as
a protest against the dismissal of a shroff, but resumed at
3 p.m. the same day. On leaving the premises at 6 p.m. however
a number of them scattered cigarettes about to show their
resentment.
page_data.zh:
工部局警务处。
刑事侦缉处。
上海，1929年1月27日。

情报报告。
劳工类

南京路145号新新公司罢工局势保持不变。1929年1月26日下午2时至3时30分，约30名罢工委员会成员在西藏北路公义里7号的工会办事处举行会议，并通过以下决议：

1. 请求当地国民党党部设法释放赵松林；该人于1月26日上午因恐吓罪在新新公司大楼外被工部局警务处逮捕。

2. 请求当地国民党党部申请签发逮捕令，缉拿潘志明和孙少白两名走狗，此二人致使警方逮捕赵松林。

3. 定于1月28日上午9时举行罢工工人大会，地点待定。

一名名为赵松龄的罢工纠察队员于1月26日上午11时30分在威海卫路被捕，罪名是企图强迫一名新新公司工人前往闸北加入工会。他将于1月28日被提解至临时法庭受审。

英商烟草公司浦东工厂约1,000名女工于1月26日上午7时罢工，以抗议一名出纳员被解雇，但于当日下午3时复工。然而，下午6时离开工厂时，其中一些人四处抛撒香烟，以示不满。
